final: WITH b AS (SELECT bu.link_to_event AS ev, e.status AS st, (bu.amount - bu.spent) AS diff FROM budget bu JOIN event e ON e.event_id = bu.link_to_event), g AS (SELECT ev, st, AVG(diff) AS gavg FROM b GROUP BY ev, st), sa AS (SELECT st, AVG(gavg) AS savg FROM g GROUP BY st), j AS (SELECT g.ev, g.st, g.gavg, g.gavg * 1.0 / sa.savg AS ratio FROM g JOIN sa ON sa.st = g.st), o AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS overall FROM j), k AS (SELECT j.gavg, j.ratio, o.overall FROM j JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE j.gavg > o.overall) SELECT AVG(gavg) AS avg_kept_group_avg, AVG(ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, AVG(gavg - overall) AS avg_kept_minus_overall FROM k
